about: Three-way merge by node / edge id. For each case: merge(base, local, remote) must equal expected.merged (JSON equality: key order is irrelevant, array order matters) and report exactly expected.conflicts, in this order. In a conflict an absent base / local / remote key means the element is absent on that side.

cases.name: different-nodes
cases.note: each side edits another node: both edits are taken, no conflict

cases.name: same-change
cases.note: the same change on both sides is taken once

cases.name: both-edited
cases.note: the same node changed differently: local kept, conflict carries base / local / remote

cases.name: edit-vs-delete-local-edits
cases.note: local edits a node the remote deleted: the edited node is kept and reported (SPEC §7); its untouched edges come back with it only when they still exist on a side

cases.name: edit-vs-delete-remote-edits
cases.note: the remote edited a node deleted locally: the remote (edited) version is kept and reported

cases.name: added-both-sides
cases.note: nodes added by both sides: appended after the base nodes sorted by Unicode scalar value ("ﬁ" U+FB01 before "😀" U+1F600, the reverse of UTF-16 order); the same id added with different values is a conflict

cases.name: deleted-node-untouched-edge
cases.note: a node deleted on one side: its edges, unchanged since the base, go with it even though the other side still lists them

cases.name: deleted-but-referenced
cases.note: the remote deleted node c; locally a new edge was attached to c and an existing edge of c was relabelled: c is restored at its base position, conflict deletedButReferenced

cases.name: edges
cases.note: edge edited on one side, deleted on the other (kept, reported); edge relabelled differently on both sides (local kept, reported)

cases.name: fields-and-viewport
cases.note: top-level fields: one-sided change taken, two-sided change = field conflict (local kept), field removed vs changed = editedAndDeleted; viewport: local wins, never a conflict

cases.name: viewport-remote-only
cases.note: only the remote moved the viewport (and local edited a node): the remote viewport is taken

cases.name: unknown-fields
cases.note: unknown node kinds, unknown fields and explicit nulls travel through a merge untouched

cases.name: duplicate-ids
cases.note: elements sharing an id inside one canvas: the first occurrence counts

cases.name: local-equals-base
cases.note: nothing changed locally: the remote document is returned untouched

cases.name: remote-equals-base
cases.note: nothing changed remotely: the local document is returned untouched (its own order included)
